en.quote: And Moses said unto the people, Remember this day, in which ye came out from Egypt, out of the house of bondage; for by strength of hand the LORD brought you out from this place: there shall no leavened bread be eaten. This day came ye out in the month Abib.
en.riddle: Remember this day, in which ye came out from Egypt
en.speaker: Moses

en.quote: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh had let the people go, that God led them not through the way of the land of the Philistines, although that was near; for God said, Lest peradventure the people repent when they see war, and they return to Egypt:
en.riddle: when they see war, and they return to Egypt
en.speaker: Pharaoh
